clues.it: Dario era accanto a un'ancora e in Plancia, ma non era accanto a uno scaffale.
clues.en: Dario was beside an anchor and on the Bridge, but was not beside a shelf.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a una pianta ed esattamente una riga a nord di Olga.
clues.en: Nino was beside a plant and exactly one row north of Olga.

clues.it: Olga era nella 7ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e in Cabina.
clues.en: Olga was in the 7th column, in the 3rd row and in the Cabin.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era nella 2ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e a nord di Vito.
clues.en: Elena was in the 2nd column, in the 5th row and north of Vito.

clues.it: Fabio era esattamente una riga a nord di Vito.
clues.en: Fabio was exactly one row north of Vito.

clues.it: Vito era accanto a un barile e in una stanza diversa da Fabio.
clues.en: Vito was beside a barrel and in a different room from Fabio.

clues.it: Irene era nella 8ª riga e in Cabina, ma non era accanto a un barile.
clues.en: Irene was in the 8th row and in the Cabin, but was not beside a barrel.

clues.it: Carla era nella 9ª riga, ma non era accanto a una pianta.
clues.en: Carla was in the 9th row, but was not beside a plant.

clues.it: Anna era nella 4ª colonna, accanto a un'ancora e in Stiva.
clues.en: Anna was in the 4th column, beside an anchor and in the Hold.

clues.it: Giada era nella 9ª colonna, in una stanza diversa da Irene e in Stiva.
clues.en: Giada was in the 9th column, in a different room from Irene and in the Hold.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Olga's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Elena lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Elena's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 2nd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 10ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 10th, column 4th.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Nino con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 11ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Nino's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 2nd, column 11th.

steps.it: Nino può stare solo nella 2ª riga: escludendola, a Dario resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Nino can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 1st, column 8th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 10ª riga: escludendola, a Giada resta una sola casella: riga 11ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 10th row: ruling it out leaves Giada a single square: row 11th, column 9th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 4ª colonna: escludendola, a Irene resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 4th column: ruling it out leaves Irene a single square: row 8th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Vito con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Vito's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 7th, column 6th.

steps.it: Fabio può stare solo nella 6ª riga.
steps.en: Fabio can only be in the 6th row.

steps.it: Ugo può stare solo nella 4ª riga.
steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 4th row.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 persone in Cambusa» non torna senza Fabio: deve stare in riga 6ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 people in the Galley” cannot add up without Fabio: they must be at row 6th, column 10th.

steps.it: Ugo può stare solo nella 1ª colonna: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 1st column: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 9th, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 persone in Plancia» non torna senza Ugo: deve stare in riga 4ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 people on the Bridge” cannot add up without Ugo: they must be at row 4th, column 1st.
